title: _timing_summary.json -- aggregated run timing v0.2
description: Produced by `dao.py aggregate-trace`, once, after a run reaches its SLA end marker. It is the only permanent artifact of the tracing layer: the raw span shards under outputs/CASE_X/_trace/ are diagnostic scratch, written without a lock by a single writer per shard (see tools/trace.py's docstring for why that is not a P5 bypass), and may be deleted at any time. Ordinary span rollups are measured from perf_counter deltas. Cross-process stage_attempt intervals are separately derived from paired wall-clock start/end trace events and never enter ordinary self-time arithmetic. Run-state started_at/completed_at remain marker-movement fields and are never substituted for missing trace events. active_s is the value the 30-minute SLA is judged on.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601. When aggregate-trace ran, NOT when the run happened.

span_count.description: Spans successfully parsed and included in the rollups.

dropped_span_lines.description: Lines that could not be parsed as a span and were discarded -- normally a torn final line from a process killed mid-write. Reported rather than repaired: losing one observation must be cheaper than any attempt to protect one. A large value here means the rollups below are incomplete and should be read with that in mind.

sla_wall_clock_s.description: Wall-clock seconds between the sla.phase1.start and sla.phase1.end markers, computed from their t_start_wall anchors (not perf_counter, which is not comparable across processes). null when either marker is absent from the trace.

human_wait_s.description: Union of all human_wait span intervals falling inside the SLA window. A union, not a sum, so two gates open at once are not counted twice.

active_s.description: sla_wall_clock_s minus human_wait_s. THIS is the number the SLA target is judged against; the raw wall clock includes human gate waiting that the pipeline cannot control. null when sla_wall_clock_s is null.

critical_path.description: The root-to-leaf chain with the greatest accumulated self-time, longest contributor first. Answers 'what would have to get faster for the run to get faster'.

share_of_total.description: self_time_s as a fraction of total self-time across all spans.

by_category.description: Self-time rollup per span category. This and by_op are the decision-making output -- 'provider 42%, lock wait 31%' -- and the plan holds implementation ordering until they exist.

total_self_time_s.description: Sum of every span's self-time. Exceeds active_s whenever real parallelism occurred -- that gap is the parallel speedup, not an error.

stage_attempts.description: Cross-process stage-attempt wall intervals paired from trace events. These never enter by_op/by_category/critical_path/total_self_time_s.

by_stage.description: Per-stage attempt cost. unattributed_active_s is not a claim about model reasoning.

closed_attempt_metrics.description: Explicitly separates the sum of closed stage-attempt active walls from their raw-wall interval union. Neither is whole-run elapsed when coverage is partial.

worker_config.description: Configured worker counts observed in pool spans, keyed by pool name.

observed_max_concurrency.description: Peak simultaneous entries actually measured, keyed by pool name. Divergence from worker_config is the finding: a pool configured for 4 that never exceeded 1 is serialised by something else.

lock_stats.description: Lock contention rollup. wait covers acquisition; held covers ownership. 'How long I waited' and 'how long I made others wait' are separate questions and separate spans.

input_class.description: Case size class per the plan's measured page distribution. Set by the caller; null when not declared.

cold_or_warm.description: cold means resume caches were cleared before the run -- only cold numbers are SLA-judgable. null when not declared.

dropped_attrs.description: Attr values discarded across all spans for not matching their category's allow-list. Non-zero means some detail was suppressed by the content filter; what was suppressed is deliberately not recorded.

observed_tool_overlap_s.description: Union of already-instrumented non-marker tool intervals inside active portions of this attempt. Null when stage ownership is ambiguous.

unattributed_active_s.description: active_wall_s minus observed tool overlap. This is NOT model reasoning time; it may contain any work absent from current tool spans.
